concepts.name: Spanish Tense-Aspect System
concepts.description: The fundamental framework for organizing time and aspect in the Spanish verb system.

concepts.name: Preterite vs. Imperfect Aspectual Contrast
concepts.description: Distinguishing perfective (bounded, completed event) from imperfective (unbounded, ongoing, habitual, or background) past aspect.

concepts.name: Preterite Regular Conjugations
concepts.description: Morphological mastery of regular -ar, -er, -ir preterite endings.

concepts.name: Imperfect Regular Conjugations
concepts.description: Morphological mastery of -aba and -ía imperfect endings.

concepts.name: High-Frequency Irregular Preterites
concepts.description: Irregular preterite stems: fui, estuve, tuve, hice, dije, pude, puse, supe, quise, vine.

concepts.name: Imperfect Irregular Forms
concepts.description: The three irregular imperfect verbs: era (ser), iba (ir), veía (ver).

concepts.name: Present Perfect (Pretérito Perfecto Compuesto)
concepts.description: Events within an open time frame (he comido hoy), contrasting with simple preterite.

concepts.name: Narrative Scene Setting vs. Punctual Events
concepts.description: Using imperfect to construct scene background and preterite to advance narrative chain.

concepts.name: Habitual & Iterative Past Actions
concepts.description: Selecting imperfect for repeated past routines without specified endpoints.

concepts.name: State-Verb Aspectual Shift
concepts.description: Aspect-dependent semantic shift in verbs like saber, conocer, querer, poder.

concepts.name: Bounded Duration in Past
concepts.description: Using preterite when a duration has an explicit beginning and end (viví dos años allí).

concepts.name: Temporal Adverbial Interactions
concepts.description: Understanding how temporal markers (ayer, siempre, mientras) interact with aspect without blindly dictating it.

concepts.name: Spontaneous Past Narrative Competence
concepts.description: Producing extended, coherent past narratives using integrated aspectual contrasts.

concepts.name: Temporal Discourse Connectors
concepts.description: Connectors orchestrating past narratives: cuando, mientras, de repente, entonces, al final.

concepts.name: Past Time Lexical Expressions
concepts.description: Temporal anchors: anoche, la semana pasada, hace dos días, en aquel entonces.

concepts.name: Spanish Prepositional Semantic Space
concepts.description: Conceptual boundaries and relations governing Spanish prepositions.

concepts.name: Por vs. Para Semantic Partition
concepts.description: The macro-contrast between retrospective/motive/path (por) and prospective/goal/recipient (para).

concepts.name: Para: Objective and Purpose
concepts.description: Forward-looking purpose, objective, or goal (para + infinitive).

concepts.name: Para: Intended Recipient
concepts.description: The destination entity or beneficiary recipient of an object or action.

concepts.name: Para: Spatial Destination
concepts.description: Direction or physical terminus of motion (salimos para Barcelona).

concepts.name: Para: Temporal Deadline
concepts.description: Point in time by which an action must conclude (para el viernes).

concepts.name: Para: Standard of Comparison
concepts.description: Judged against a reference class (para un niño, habla muy bien).

concepts.name: Por: Cause and Motivation
concepts.description: Backward-looking reason, antecedent cause, or motive (por la lluvia).

concepts.name: Por: On Behalf Of / Substitution
concepts.description: Acting in someone's place or for their sake (trabajé por ti hoy).

concepts.name: Por: Spatial Path and Transit
concepts.description: Movement through, along, or by a physical space (caminamos por la playa).

concepts.name: Por: Approximate Time and Duration
concepts.description: Duration spanning an approximate period (por dos horas, por la tarde).

concepts.name: Por: Economic Exchange and Trade
concepts.description: Price, barter, or substitution of equivalent value (pagué diez euros por él).

concepts.name: Por: Means and Medium
concepts.description: Medium of communication or transportation (por teléfono, por correo).

concepts.name: Por/Para Fixed Formulaic Chunks
concepts.description: Lexicalized collocations: por favor, por ejemplo, gracias por, por fin, para siempre.

concepts.name: A vs. En Spatial Prepositions
concepts.description: Motion toward (a) vs. static location (en), providing contrastive preposition baseline.

concepts.name: English Undifferentiated 'For'
concepts.description: English L1 concept mapping recipient, duration, purpose, and exchange to a single lexeme.

concepts.name: Penultimate Syllable Stress (Llanas)
concepts.description: Natural stress on penultimate syllable for words ending in vowel, n, or s (preparatory node).

concepts.name: Inter-Word Vowel Linking (Sinalefa)
concepts.description: Contraction of adjacent vowels across word boundaries in connected speech (preparatory node).

concepts.name: Declarative Sentence Intonation
concepts.description: Pitch contour across Spanish narrative assertions (preparatory node).
